confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Siena's pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is volatile in July, peak season, when Palio-related and summer demand push prices up. Hotel anchors are the least certain. The FX observation for 2026-10-15 was taken from RBA page search results, and I did not open the RBA table directly; the RBA exchange-rates page should be checked before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Tuscan hill towns with heavy tourism demand, such as Lucca, Orvieto and Montepulciano, adjusted for Siena's typically high summer hotel rates and its central historic-centre restaurant prices.
